_description: CrowdStrike Falcon EDR event → AKSI control ID mapping. CrowdStrike Falcon is the dominant endpoint detection and response (EDR) platform, providing host- and process-level visibility for agents that operate on developer/server endpoints. Falcon's Streaming API surfaces DetectionSummaryEvent, IncidentSummaryEvent, AuthActivityAuditEvent (Falcon Identity Protection), and UserActivityAuditEvent records that include severity (1-5 + label), status, MITRE ATT&CK tactic + technique, behaviors with confidence scores, autonomous response actions_taken, is_authorized_response, is_managed_endpoint flags, and Linux/Windows/Mac platform metadata. Critical-severity open detections become DE-01 FAIL; High-severity open detections become DE-01 FAIL; High closed+true_positive becomes PR-05 FAIL (audit-trail of confirmed real); High closed+false_positive becomes PR-05 PASS. MITRE tactics drive control selection: Exfiltration → PR-04 FAIL (top-priority data-loss); Credential Access → PR-01 FAIL; Privilege Escalation → PR-02 FAIL; Initial Access on High/Critical → PR-01 FAIL (active intrusion); Lateral Movement → PR-02 FAIL (post-compromise spread); Impact → DE-01 FAIL. Specific MITRE techniques map directly: T1078/T1110/T1003/T1056 → PR-01 (credential techniques); T1041/T1567/T1011 → PR-04 (exfil channels); T1059/T1106/T1620 → PR-03 (interpreter abuse). Autonomous-response governance: actions_taken contains isolate_host without is_authorized_response → PR-02 FAIL; low-confidence (<50) on autonomous response → PR-03 FLAG. Production-named hosts (prod*/server*/agent-*/svc-*) without is_managed_endpoint → PR-01 FLAG (unmanaged endpoint exposure). AuthActivityAuditEvent with High/Critical severity → PR-01 FAIL (Falcon Identity Protection detection).
